sources.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Hand-painted outlined 2D game character model sheet. Image1 panel7 enemy example defines detailed Sporeling identity ONLY; ignore all text/scenery/other enemies. Image2 defines squat mushroom silhouette and relative short scale ONLY, not flat rendering. Sporeling is a small squat woodland mushroom creature, broad red cap with creamy irregular pale spots and tan gills, ivory short stem body, moss/root frills at base, small dark expressive eyes, two small root arms and two stubby root feet. Match panel7 red spotted cap, ivory/moss palette. No clothes, weapons or extra limbs. Four-view model proposal, FOUR full-body views in a single horizontal row of four equal cells: front, right profile, back, three-quarter-right. Landscape canvas, each view fully isolated with ample empty padding. No labels or text. Subject interior opaque; genuine transparent background, no floor, cast shadow, haze, scenery, labels, borders or text. Consistent scale and same design four views. Each view fully fits own cell with generous padding.
